Huawei Canada has an immediate 8-12 month Co-op opening for an Engineer. 
 About the team: 
 Huawei Canada's Advanced Optical Technology Lab focuses on advanced R&D in high-performance optical communications and networking. Our expert team specializes in transmission algorithms, systems, physics, and AI-driven optical network management. The lab engages in projects ranging from deep research to developing key product features, actively participating in standards organizations and collaborative research with partners. Our multicultural environment fosters innovation, mentorship, and a passion for learning. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, this lab is your ideal place. 
 About the job: 
 Working on the next generation of short-reach and data center interconnect (DCI) networks. In this role you will focus on the design and simulation of Intensity-Modulated Direct-Detection (IMDD) transmission systems operating over cutting-edge Hollow-Core Fiber (HCF). Given the physical properties of HCF, efficient signaling and equalization methods are fundamental to achieve cost and power efficient optical links. 
 Modeling of end-to-end non-coherent optical transmission system. 
 Modeling of Hollow-Core Fiber and the impact of gas absorption on the transmission. 
 Exploring efficient signaling and equalization to combat channel induced fading profiles. 
 Studying the impact of high launch power on the system reach and performance. 
 The total target annual compensation (based on 2,080 hours per year) ranges from $58,000 to $104,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise. 
 About the ideal candidate: 
 Currently enrolled in Master’s/PhD program in Electrical Engineering program or equivalent. 
 Solid background in non-coherent optical fiber transmission and reception. 
 Deep understanding of direct-detection systems, transceiver limitations, and noise penalties (e.g., RIN, thermal noise, shot noise). 
 Familiarity with programming languages like Matlab and/or Python. 
 Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team. 
 A publication record on similar topics is an asset. 
 Applicants must be enrolled in a co-op program and be registered for an official co-op work term for the full duration of the employment period.

Laboratory Attendant 1 
Location: PHO Corporate Office & Toronto Laboratory, 661 University Avenue, Toronto, ON 
Department: Front End Processing  
 This posting is to fill a current vacancy.
 The Role: 
To provide laboratory attendant services in support of laboratory operations. 
 Key Responsibilities- 
 Receives pre-packaged samples and transports to appropriate laboratory areas.
 Receives, opens and distributes mail and faxes.
 Picks up bio-hazardous waste and packages for disposal according to safety standards.
 Completes logs and records as required (i.e. eyewash, spill kit, bench cleaning etc.).
 Opens, sorts and racks specimens upon receipt.
 Washes glassware including loading, operating and unloading equipment.
 Prepares clean glassware for sterilization, i.e. capping tubes.
 Sorts and restocks clean glassware and other laboratory related inventory (e.g. gloves, labels etc.).
 Operates and performs minor maintenance on equipment (e.g. dishwashers, material lift, Biological Safety Cabinets (BSC)).
 Completes logs for temperature monitoring and alerts supervisor/delegate when out of range.
 Prepares solutions (i.e. bench top cleaner - 70% ethanol or bleach products).
 Delivers/receives laboratory supplies from supply chain.
 Receives and records lot numbers of incoming supplies either electronically or in log book.
 Reviews and records inventory numbers on logs and alerts appropriate supervisor/delegate when there is a need to order.
 Packages materials/samples for delivery to onsite and regional laboratories.
 Archives samples in designated areas.
 Prints barcode labels, checks specimen bags to ensure all samples have been removed, replaces sponges/racks etc. in the bags.
 Maintains filing systems as required including filing of requisitions daily; locating requisitions (in PDF) as requested by other laboratory staff.
 May provide data entry and scanning of laboratory requisitions into the Laboratory Information System (LIS) and other software (e.g. Excel, Access) and Public Health Ontario (PHO) systems (e.g. Laboratory Result Management Application (LRMA)).
 Assists with scanning, searching for requisitions not scanned and records storage process.
 Trains and orients new team members as assigned.
 Performs other duties or projects as assigned.
 Knowledge and Skills- 
 Knowledge of medical terminology and laboratory safety procedures to provide a range of laboratory services in support of operations.
 Knowledge of computer systems, familiarity with laboratory information systems, MS office products such as Word and Excel.
 Proficient computer skills necessary to work with automated, computer driven equipment.
 Knowledge of general laboratory safety procedures to provide laboratory attendant services.
 Knowledge of operation procedures for equipment i.e. glassware washing machine, ultrasonic tank, material lift.
 Familiar with WHIMIS requirements to ensure adherence to standards.
 Knowledge of computer systems for basic record keeping.
 Oral communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with peers in order to seek direction on requirements.
 Written communication skills to complete basic logs.
 Education and Experience- 
 High school diploma.
 Attributes and Competencies- 
 Regular requirement to lift up to 10 kgs.
 Regular requirement to perform repetitive tasks such as cleaning flasks and tubes and to stand for extended period of time.
 Requires physical activity such as walking, lifting, stretching, bending.
 Works within a Laboratory environment which contains hazardous and infectious materials, odors, noise generated from automated analyzers, some temperature extremes, such as walk in fridges and freezers.
 Works shifts as assigned.
 Works within well established procedures for a Laboratory Attendant and within PHO Lab Standard Operating Procedures.
 Recognizes the potential hazard of samples being delivered and seeks guidance as required.
 Situations not covered by specific instructions or detailed SOP are referred to supervisor.

DESCRIPTION DE L’ENTREPRISE 
 Ludia est un studio innovant et dynamique, spécialisé dans le développement de jeux mobiles. Basé à Montréal depuis 2007, chaque mois, plus de 3,5 millions de joueurs à travers le monde plongent dans nos univers. Notre portfolio combine des franchises mondiales emblématiques et des créations originales, incluant Jurassic World™ Alive, Jurassic World™: The Game, Dragons: Rise of Berk, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends, et bien d’autres.
 Avec plus de 500 millions de téléchargements depuis notre fondation , nous entamons un chapitre exaltant en tant que studio indépendant, où la croissance est portée par la passion de notre équipe et de nos joueurs.
 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE 
 En tant que Responsable Assurance Qualité (QA) sur Jurassic World Alive, vous serez responsable de définir et de piloter la stratégie qualité d’un jeu mobile live service joué par une communauté mondiale.
 À la tête de l’équipe QA du projet, vous veillerez à ce que les nouvelles fonctionnalités, mises à jour et contenus répondent à nos standards de qualité avant leur mise entre les mains des joueurs. Vous établirez les priorités de test en fonction des risques, assurerez une couverture adéquate des différentes composantes du jeu et fournirez à l’équipe de production une vision claire de la stabilité et de la qualité de chaque version.
 🎯 RESPONSABILITÉS 
 Stratégie QA & Qualité 
 Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie QA du projet en fonction de la roadmap, des priorités de production et des risques.
 Analyser les nouvelles fonctionnalités et changements afin d’identifier les risques, les besoins de validation et la couverture de test appropriée.
 Superviser la création et l’exécution des plans de test pour les fonctionnalités, contenus, systèmes et mises à jour du jeu.
 Assurer une couverture adéquate des différentes composantes du jeu, notamment les interactions client-serveur, sauvegardes et données joueurs, fonctionnalités en ligne, intégration des assets et compatibilité des appareils.
 Veiller à la conformité et à la compatibilité des versions sur les plateformes mobiles iOS et Android.
 Releases & Gestion des Risques 
 Évaluer continuellement la stabilité du jeu et les risques associés aux bugs, nouvelles fonctionnalités et changements apportés au produit.
 Piloter la validation QA des releases et fournir aux parties prenantes une évaluation claire des risques et de la préparation de chaque version avant son déploiement.
 Identifier les enjeux critiques pouvant affecter l’expérience joueur et assurer leur priorisation avec les équipes concernées.
 Contribuer à la planification des releases et communiquer de façon proactive les contraintes, risques et délais de validation.
 Soutenir l’investigation et la résolution des problèmes rencontrés en production et contribuer aux analyses post-release lorsque nécessaire.
 Leadership & Gestion d'Équipe 
 Encadrer et mobiliser l’équipe QA du projet en établissant des priorités, attentes et objectifs clairs.
 Planifier et répartir les efforts de test en fonction de la roadmap, des releases et des capacités de l’équipe.
 Accompagner les membres de l’équipe dans leur développement professionnel par du coaching, du feedback régulier et des objectifs de progression.
 Favoriser une culture de qualité, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue au sein de l’équipe.
 Anticiper les besoins en ressources QA et collaborer avec la Production afin d’adapter la capacité de test aux besoins du projet.
 Collaboration & Amélioration Continue 
 Agir comme principal point de contact QA auprès des équipes de développement et de Production.
 Communiquer clairement l’état de qualité du jeu, la progression des tests, les risques identifiés et les enjeux pouvant affecter une release.
 Participer activement à la planification de production et contribuer à établir des échéanciers réalistes en fonction des besoins de validation.
 Collaborer avec les différentes disciplines afin d’intégrer les considérations de qualité plus tôt dans le processus de développement.
 Faire évoluer les processus, outils, métriques et pratiques QA afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, la couverture et la visibilité sur la qualité du projet.
 Contribuer aux initiatives et meilleures pratiques QA à l’échelle du studio.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 🎮 Expériences et Compétences 
 5 années et plus d’expérience en Assurance Qualité dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo, dont au moins 2 années dans un rôle de leadership ou de gestion d’équipe QA.
 Expérience significative en développement et en QA de jeux mobiles, idéalement sur un produit live service.
 Expérience dans la planification et la coordination de cycles de test complexes et de releases régulières.
 Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et de l’intégration de fonctionnalités dans un environnement de production Agile.
 Bonne compréhension des environnements iOS et Android, incluant les enjeux de compatibilité, de déploiement et de validation propres aux plateformes mobiles.
 Bonne compréhension des architectures et enjeux liés aux jeux connectés : client-serveur, données joueurs, sauvegardes, services backend et fonctionnalités en ligne.
 Capacité à analyser et prioriser les bugs selon leur sévérité, leur impact joueur et le niveau de risque pour une release.
 Expérience avec des outils de gestion de bugs, de tests et de production tels que Jira ou des outils équivalents.
 Expérience avec les méthodologies Agile / Scrum.
 💡 Traits Additionels 
 Leadership mobilisateur et capacité à développer, accompagner et responsabiliser une équipe QA.
 Excellent jugement et capacité à prendre des décisions fondées sur le risque, particulièrement dans un contexte de production et de release.
 Excellentes aptitudes en planification, organisation et gestion des priorités dans un environnement où plusieurs initiatives avancent simultanément.
 Approche proactive axée sur la résolution de problèmes et l’amélioration continue.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à présenter clairement les enjeux de qualité et les risques à différentes parties prenantes.
 Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et à influencer les décisions sans être propriétaire de toutes les disciplines concernées.
 Souci du détail tout en conservant une vision globale de la qualité du produit et de l’expérience joueur.
 🌍 Compétences Bilingues : Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais pour communiquer efficacement avec des équipes et des fournisseurs divers.
 🏢 Type de Travail 
 Ce poste Hybrid nécessite une présence 2 jours par semaine au bureau.
 Les candidatures éligibles pour ce poste devront être des citoyens dans la province du Québec avec un droit de travail au Canada.
 POURQUOI LUDIA ? 
 Chez Ludia, nous croyons qu’un milieu de travail devrait être aussi inspirant que les jeux que nous créons. Voici ce que tu peux attendre en nous rejoignant :
 👓 Flexibilité : Options hybrides, horaire flexible et un studio vibrant au cœur du Vieux-Montréal.
 🔋 Bien-être : Salaire compétitif, avantages dès le premier jour, contribution REER, vacances généreuses et journées mobiles.
 🌟 Développement : Formations, mentorat, ateliers et opportunités de carrière dans l’univers du jeu vidéo.
 🎮 Culture : Une équipe de passionné·e·s qui crée des expériences inoubliables où l’innovation et la créativité sont au rendez-vous.
 Nous valorisons et célébrons la diversité au sein de notre équipe, et nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif où chacun·e peut s’épanouir et partager sa perspective unique. 
 Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons à postuler — et nous avons hâte de te rencontrer ! 
 _________________________________________________________________ 
 COMPANY DESCRIPTION 
 Ludia is an innovative and dynamic studio specializing in mobile game development. Based in Montreal since 2007, more than 3.5 million players around the world dive into our universes every month. Our portfolio combines iconic global franchises and original creations, including Jurassic World™ Alive, Jurassic World™: The Game, Dragons: Rise of Berk, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends, and many more.
 With more than 500 million downloads since our founding , we are entering an exciting new chapter as an independent studio, where growth is driven by the passion of our team and our players.
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 As QA Lead on Jurassic World Alive, you will be responsible for defining and driving the quality strategy for a live-service mobile game played by a global community.
 Leading the project's QA team, you will ensure that new features, updates, and content meet our quality standards before reaching players.  COMPANY OVERVIEW 
 The Kitchen brings together a range of disciplines and capabilities. It’s a team of creatives, producers, data analysts and social experts working together to deliver remarkable ideas that live in a variety of mediums, from everything from social to TV. This team moves at the speed of culture. Our incredible team has been recognized internationally by industry giants like Cannes, One Show and was named Campaign's Global ‘In-House Agency of The Year’, further solidifying our position as a leader in the industry. We want individuals who are passionate about producing award-winning work and have an innate drive to their craft and are eager to generate innovative ideas both within and outside of the brief. 
 THE ROLE 
 We’re looking for an experienced, well-rounded Senior Editor to join our Production team in Toronto and play an important role in our growing in-house post-production capability. 
 Reporting directly to the Executive Producer, Production , you’ll work closely with a robust team of Producers across Toronto and Chicago, as well as our Creative, Account and broader agency teams and, from time to time, directly with our brand partners. 
 Our work lives primarily within the food, beverage and food-adjacent space and spans everything from fast-turnaround social and digital content to broadcast commercials and larger integrated advertising campaigns. We’re looking for someone who understands the pace, craft and collaborative nature of agency production and is equally comfortable digging into an edit independently, working alongside a Creative team or leading a supervised session with internal and brand stakeholders. 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Lead offline editorial across broadcast, digital, social, branded content and integrated advertising campaigns. 
 Edit work across a wide range of formats and durations, from short-form and social content through :06, :15, :30 and longer-form storytelling. 
 Partner closely with Producers, Creatives, Account teams and brand stakeholders throughout the post-production process, from initial assemblies through creative approval and delivery. Participate in pre-production and creative conversations when appropriate, helping teams anticipate editorial opportunities, coverage needs, post-production considerations and potential efficiencies before cameras roll. 
 Participate in and lead supervised edit sessions, confidently navigating feedback and contributing editorial solutions in real time. 
 Bring a strong editorial perspective to the work, helping teams find the strongest story, performance, pacing, structure and creative execution rather than simply executing a brief. 
 Create and implement motion graphics as part of day-to-day editorial, including supers, typography, transitions, end cards, graphic treatments and other motion elements required to bring an edit to completion. 
 Perform light colour correction and grading when appropriate, while collaborating with specialized external partners for more advanced colour and finishing requirements. 
 Manage multiple edits, versions, aspect ratios, formats and deliverables across projects of varying scale and complexity. 
 Prepare and adapt work across broadcast, social and digital specifications, including short-form cutdowns and platform-specific versioning. 
 Perform stock music searches and provide a creative POV to creatives/CDs on music direction 
 Collaborate with external post-production partners across advanced motion design, animation, VFX, colour, audio and finishing when projects require additional specialization. 
 Maintain highly organized project files, media, working assets and archives throughout the lifecycle of a project. 
 Perform editorial QC and prepare final files for review, approval and delivery, ensuring accuracy across picture, audio, graphics, supers, aspect ratios, versioning and technical specifications. 
 Work confidently within established post workflows while helping us continue to develop and strengthen our growing in-house editorial capability. 
 Work on-site from our Liberty Village office during designated in-office days, currently Tuesday and Thursday. 
 Work effectively across both in-person and remote editorial workflows, collaborating with teams and stakeholders across Toronto and Chicago. 
 Experience with collaborative review platforms such as Frame.io and remote post-production workflows. 
 Share knowledge, best practices and technical expertise with the broader team, contributing to the continued development of our editorial standards and capabilities. 
 Have experience with Extreme Reach submission or uploading for broadcast deliverables. 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 7+ years of professional editorial experience within an advertising agency, in-house agency, production company or post-production environment, with agency and/or in-house experience strongly preferred. 
 A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating editorial craft, creative thinking and a high level of polish across finished work. 
 Demonstrated experience working on food, beverage and/or food-adjacent advertising and content . 
 Extensive experience with professional NLE systems and contemporary post-production workflows. 
 Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and comfort working within the broader Adobe Creative Suite . 
 Strong proficiency in After Effects , with the ability to independently design, build and implement motion graphics required for everyday advertising and content work. 
 Working knowledge of Photoshop and an understanding of how design assets move between creative and editorial workflows. 
 Experience with DaVinci Resolve or Baselight is an asset. 
 Comfort performing light colour correction and grading, with an understanding of when work should transition to a dedicated colourist or finishing partner. 
 Experience with advanced 2D or 3D animation is a significant plus, but not a requirement. 
 Strong understanding of media management, codecs, formats, versioning, conforming and preparing projects for downstream colour, VFX, audio and online finishing. 
 Experience working directly with Creative, Production and Account teams as well as clients or brand stakeholders. 
 Strong creative instincts and an ability to interpret feedback, contribute ideas and recommend editorial solutions. 
 Comfortable working independently while managing competing priorities, tight timelines and multiple stakeholders. 
 Highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative and calm within a fast-moving production environment. 
 Demonstrated ability to take editorial ownership of a project from initial assembly through approval, proactively identifying creative and technical needs rather than waiting for direction at each stage. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 You become a trusted creative and production partner across the agency, someone Producers, Creatives and brand teams want in the room early and rely on when the work gets complicated. 
 You bring both craft and practicality to post-production: strong editorial instincts, motion capabilities, excellent technical knowledge and an understanding of what it takes to move modern advertising work efficiently from footage through finished creative. 
 You’re equally comfortable crafting the hero :30, finding the :06 cutdown hiding inside it, adapting the work across platforms and building the motion elements needed to make each execution feel considered rather than simply resized. 
 Just as importantly, you’ll play an active role in shaping our growing in-house post-production capability. You’ll bring your experience and perspective to how we structure workflows, technology and editorial standards, external partnerships and ways of working, helping us build a post-production model that can scale across our North American team.

Individual compensation within this range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. This range represents the expected base salary for this role and does not include other elements of The Kitchen’s total rewards program.

The role has no direct reports, but there is substantial opportunity for advancement, and the incumbent is well supported by a strong sales function (including a robust marketing arm), peers, delivery leads and management. Success is measured by new relationships opened with executive decision-makers, qualified pipeline built and new business won across the full ReVisionz portfolio.
 Core Responsibilities
 Prospecting & Pipeline Generation: Build and sustain a qualified pipeline through consistent outbound activity (calls, meetings, LinkedIn and email outreach), with steady quarter-over-quarter growth in new client meetings and qualified opportunities that supports revenue targets.
 Industry Insight: Gather first-hand intelligence on what is happening across target industries and client operations, and tailor each conversation to it rather than relying on a canned pitch.
 Target Account Mapping: Identify target owner-operators and map their stakeholders, initiatives and buying triggers to focus outreach where ReVisionz can win.
 Existing Client Opportunities: Identify and win new work with existing ReVisionz clients by introducing solutions they do not yet use.
 Opportunity Qualification: Qualify opportunities early on fit, budget, timing and decision process, and keep lead and deal records accurate and current in the CRM.
 Discovery & Business Cases: Lead discovery conversations that uncover each client’s business problems and corporate initiatives, and build executive-level business cases tied to corporate strategy that create demand for ReVisionz solutions.
 Solution Shaping: Shape tailored offerings such as assessments, roadmaps, software implementations and managed services in collaboration with ReVisionz practice leads.
 Proposals & Closure: Lead enterprise pursuits, proposals and RFP responses through to signed statements of work and master services agreements.
 Market Presence: Raise ReVisionz’s profile as a recognized voice in target industries through speaking engagements, executive forums and association leadership, and generate warm introductions through technology partners, alumni and existing clients.
 Market Strategy Input: Share industry insight with management to shape go-to-market priorities and target industries.
 Marketing Collaboration: Partner with marketing on client case studies, project summaries and targeted campaigns that support pipeline growth.
 Sales-to-Delivery Handoff: Ensure a clean handoff to delivery, aligning client expectations, scope, commitments and key relationships with the delivery team.
 Capabilities & Competencies
 Opens doors quickly with C-level executives across operations, engineering, capital projects and IT who set strategy and approve major investments, earning credibility in early conversations and sustaining relationships between opportunities.
 Sells consultatively, framing value around business outcomes and positioning ReVisionz as a trusted, software-agnostic advisor and systems integrator.
 Navigates complex enterprise buying organizations, including executive committees, maintaining momentum across 6–18 month sales cycles.
 Negotiates pricing, scope and commercial terms for time-and-materials and fixed-fee services work, supported by sales leadership and corporate administration, while protecting both margin and the client relationship.
 Learns new solutions rapidly and connects them to each client’s priorities in clear, executive-level language, from a first conversation to a formal presentation.
 Qualifications & Experience

 15+ years in business development, sales, consulting or senior operations, engineering or capital project roles where success depended on building client relationships and advancing high-value solutions.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

There’s a wide gap between an agent that works in a demo and one that works across millions of live transactions.  Closing it is the job.  You’ll embed with the teams and customers who depend on AI — risk, fraud, collections, payments, support, developer experience — and design, build, and ship agentic systems into their production environments.  You’ll also help build the platform underneath: Paytm’s AI inference platform (Pi) and the agentic runtime, orchestration, and tooling that lets agents reason, plan, use tools, and run multi-step workflows safely.

What you’ll do: Embed & deploy 
 Tackle greenfield problems alongside internal teams and customers — scope ambiguous needs and build agents from scratch that fit how they actually work.
 Own deployments end-to-end: discovery, build, integration, activation, and the tuning that earns trust and adoption.
 Lead pilots and demos, drive adoption, and clear blockers before they stall a rollout.

 Build observability, tracing, and guardrails that prove agents are safe and keep them safe as models and data drift.

 v4 Hooks Architect 
 A senior builder is sought who operates at the intersection of protocol engineering and DeFi product design. This individual will design, prototype, and productionize Uniswap v4 hooks that unlock new markets. Areas of focus include dynamic fee markets, JIT‑aware liquidity protections, programmable compliance for RWAs, solver/intents integrations, perps/credit primitives, and beyond.
 Why this role exists 
 - Hooks are the frontier. Uniswap v4 turns AMM behavior into a programmable surface. The ecosystem needs more production-ready hooks to go from tinkering to real usage.
 - Builders need partners. High‑quality hooks require deep protocol knowledge and product instincts designing the onchain mechanics, the incentives, and a path to distribution.
 - The mandate: accelerate onchain trading activity and protocol support across Uniswap deployments. This role is central to that impact.
 The work 
 - Bring product thinking for market‑tailored hooks: Ideate/incubate high‑leverage ideas across market segments: volatile pairs (ETH/USDx, xBTC/USDx), correlated/stable pairs (USDx–USDx), and order sizes from small retail to whales. Translate these insights into concrete hook specs with clear adoption and measurement plans.
 - Architect & ship hooks: Own the full lifecycle from whiteboard to an audited mainnet deployment that advances the roadmap (fee dynamics, liquidity management, MEV/LVR capture, KYC/attestations, JIT, etc.).
 - Author canonical patterns: Publish reference implementations, hook templates, and “living specs” that other teams can safely extend.
 - Design with distribution in mind: Co‑create adoption plans with other DeFi protocols (lending/ALMs/vaults), aggregators/routers, intent layers, asset issuers. Ship the adapters, simulators, and SDK glue to make integration easy.
 - Own security & correctness: Threat model hooks, define invariants, fuzz and formally verify critical paths, and partner with external auditors.
 - Data & feedback loops: Work with the data team to instrument events/metrics, write Dune/Flipside dashboards, and run controlled experiments to tune parameters (fees, tick ranges, JIT thresholds) based on observed flow, MEV, and LP PnL.
 A week in this role might look like 
 - Ideate, architect, and implement a new stable‑stable hook designed to win $100k+ trades (market‑share target, slippage/fee behavior, routing incentives, aggregator integration plan).
 - Design abstractions for reusability and code hygiene. Upstream libraries into a canonical toolkit.
 - Pair programming and code reviews with an external team on a lending rehypothecation hook design and implementation.
 - Write Foundry tests and fuzzers for beforeSwap/afterSwap invariants; benchmark gas and optimize with Yul where it pays.
 - Coordinate with an aggregator on simulation support and revert reasons; land a PR to their router.
 What success looks like 
 3 months
 - Land one high‑leverage hook in audit or on testnet with credible distribution partners.
 - Establish a metrics schema and dashboard framework for hook evaluation (LP PnL, orderflow capture, effective liquidity).
 6 months
 - Two production hooks with measurable flow/TVL and zero critical incidents.
 - Clear adoption playbooks for routers, wallets, and solver layers; at least three third‑party teams shipping on these patterns.
 - Demonstrated LP or trader outcome improvements.
 - Moved the needle on core KPIs.

 - Deep Solidity and EVM internals; strong with Foundry, fuzzing, property tests; comfort reading/implementing community smart contracts.

 How the team works 
 - Product focused: Intentional about building for target markets instead of randomly throwing ideas. Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Activation Manager at Ramp, you’ll help partner-sourced customers improve how they manage their finances. You’ll own a book of approximately 80 customers, guiding them through implementation and helping their teams adopt new workflows, including Ramp’s AI and agentic finance capabilities.

This role goes beyond getting customers live. You’ll work with finance leaders, their teams, and external partners to understand what needs to change, address resistance, and make sure customers see measurable value from Ramp. We’re looking for someone who’s led customers through change, is comfortable working with CFOs and Controllers, and uses AI regularly in their own work.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Guide partner-sourced customers from implementation through ongoing workflow adoption, with accountability for time to value and business outcomes.

 - Build a change management plan for each account: identify stakeholders, understand what’s slowing adoption, and help customer teams work through it.

 - Help CFOs and Controllers measure Ramp’s impact, including improvements in close cycles, spend visibility, variance reduction, and ROI.

 - Manage relationships across the customer’s organization, including finance leadership relationships you’ll own independently.

 - Use AI to prepare for calls, build customer materials, synthesize data, spot account risks, and reduce repetitive work.

 - Help customers evaluate and adopt Ramp’s agentic finance capabilities, including the changes these workflows require in their teams’ day-to-day work.

 - Work with Channel Partner Managers, Partner Consulting, Account Executives, and Technical Consulting to coordinate implementations and identify opportunities to expand Ramp’s use.

 - Share recurring customer needs, product gaps, and feedback with Product.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 5+ years in customer success, consulting, implementations, or a similar customer-facing role, with a consistent record of delivering customer outcomes and exceeding goals.

 - Experience driving workflow adoption and managing organizational change, including navigating stakeholder resistance. Finance or fintech experience is helpful but not required.

 - Regular, hands-on use of AI to prepare for calls, synthesize information, create customer-facing materials, and automate repetitive tasks.

 - The ability to build a business case for workflow changes and explain their financial impact to CFOs and Controllers, connecting implementation progress to business results.

 - Enough technical depth to work with Product and Engineering on integrations, APIs, and workflow design, and explain those topics to customers.

 - Success in a fast-paced GTM environment, ideally at a SaaS or fintech company.

Botpress est la plateforme d’agents IA pour le support client. Nous construisons des agents IA qui résolvent les tickets au lieu de simplement y répondre, pour les équipes de support qui gèrent un volume réel de conversations. Notre mission : faire en sorte que l’IA travaille pour les personnes qui font le travail.
 À propos du poste 
 Nous misons sur une approche sales-led, et ce poste la rend reproductible. Le problème le plus important de l’entreprise en ce moment est de bâtir du pipeline avec de nouveaux comptes qui nous correspondent. Vous serez responsable du volet marketing : la demande auprès de comptes de plus grande taille, jusqu’à l’enterprise, par l’expérimentation et une approche multicanale.
 Nous serons honnêtes sur notre stade. Le produit peut faire beaucoup, nous savons à qui il s’adresse, et nous apprenons encore quels canaux attirent ces personnes de façon prévisible. Vous aurez en tout temps quelques canaux à piloter avec une certaine prévisibilité et une poignée d’expériences. On s’attendra à ce que vous arrêtiez ce qui ne fonctionne pas, et que vous le disiez tôt.
 Responsabilités 
 Événements : des événements privés sur invitation, et notre présence autour des grandes conférences du secteur (nos propres dîners et salles en marge de celles-ci). Le Marketing pilote, les Ventes amènent les gens dans la salle. Vous disposerez de ressources pour l’exécution, mais c’est vous qui portez et dirigez la vision : où nous sommes présents, pourquoi, et qui nous voulons autour de la table.
 Publipostage et cadeaux d’affaires
 Programmes ABM : les actions ciblant la liste de comptes nommés, du premier contact jusqu’à la passation aux Ventes
 Médias payants, via notre agence ou à l’interne, avec un budget modeste qui doit faire ses preuves une action à la fois pour pouvoir croître
 Les intrants marketing de notre moteur outbound : ciblage, segments, messages et contenu utilisé dans les séquences. Vous êtes responsable de la liste et de la prospection aux côtés de notre équipe de BDR.
 Le portefeuille d’expériences d’acquisition : ce que nous testons, dans quel ordre, et ce que nous en apprenons
 Les agences et fournisseurs derrière ces canaux : le brief, le budget, et la décision de les garder, d’y mettre fin ou d’internaliser
 Vos 90 premiers jours 
 Améliorer l’impact de nos publicités payantes
 Lancer un atelier IA en personne, sur invitation, pour les comptes cibles
 Expérimenter une campagne de publipostage
 Décider de conserver notre fournisseur outbound ou d’internaliser
 Construire les premières actions ABM sur la liste de comptes nommés, avec le CRO et les Ventes
 Faire fonctionner le podcast, les événements et la liste outbound comme une seule démarche multi-threaded, pour qu’un compte pertinent entende parler de nous plus d’une fois
 Curieux, et capable de prendre du recul. Vous tirez les fils : pourquoi, qu’est-ce qui le prouverait, quelle est la plus petite façon de le tester. Vous savez réfléchir de manière stratégique et vous forger un point de vue. Puis vous lancez l’expérience quand même.
 Un grand sens du suivi. Vous êtes dans l’action. Ce que vous commencez, vous le terminez, et vous bouclez la boucle sans qu’on ait à vous relancer.
 Dans l’action, et vous savez déléguer. Vous couvrez plus de terrain en confiant du travail à des agences, des pigistes, des agents et des collègues, et en les briefant bien.
 Le 80/20 par instinct. Vous repérez les quelques éléments à plus fort impact et commencez par là. Plus n’est pas mieux. Nous testons la version minimale viable d’une action avant d’investir dans la version complète.
 Expert d’un canal, prêt à improviser sur les autres. Vous êtes peut-être spécialiste des médias payants. Vous devrez tout de même construire de A à Z une action événementielle et une action de publipostage, et nous voulons quelqu’un qui en a envie.
 Vous vous appuyez fortement sur l’IA. C’est la devise de l’équipe et de l’entreprise, et cela fait partie de l’entrevue. Dites-nous comment vous enrichiriez l’équipe avec votre réflexion, vos processus et vos agents IA. Si vous ne vous appuyez pas fortement sur l’IA, ce poste n’est pas pour vous.
 Données et instinct, en équilibre. Vous lisez les chiffres, et vous vous fiez aussi à votre lecture d’une salle, d’un compte, d’un message. Vous savez dire lequel vous avez utilisé et pourquoi.
 L’humilité intellectuelle. Vous dites facilement : « Je me suis trompé, voici ce qui m’a fait changer d’avis. » Nous vous interrogerons sur un échec dont vous êtes sincèrement fier, et sur quelque chose que vous avez construit et qui vous gêne un peu.
 L’équipe que vous rejoindrez 
 Une équipe marketing restreinte, senior et très opérationnelle. Croissance et product-led growth, SEO, AEO et contenu, marque et design, et marketing produit. Les médias payants et l’outbound passent par des agences que vous gérerez. L’équipe grandit grâce à l’IA, pas en effectifs, par choix : chacun construit ses propres compétences et agents sur notre propre plateforme, et toutes les deux semaines, nous organisons un Marketing AI Open Hour où quelqu’un présente ce qu’il a construit. Vous rejoindrez des gens qui livrent, et qui s’attendent à ce que vous montriez aussi votre travail.
 Pourquoi rejoindre cette équipe 
 Vous relevez du VP Croissance/Marketing, qui donne beaucoup de rétroaction et l’intègre au poste : un 1:1 de réflexion mensuel, un point de coaching tous les deux mois, et une rétroaction précise, rapide et visible. Nous avançons vite et sans ego. Nous assumons 100 % de la responsabilité des résultats, avec curiosité plutôt que blâme. Nous nous appuyons sur les données et l’instinct, et nous essayons l’IA avant d’ajouter des gens. Vous avez l’occasion de bâtir le moteur d’acquisition d’une approche sales-led, pas d’en hériter.
 Avec qui vous travaillez 
 Au quotidien, vous travaillez avec le CRO et l’équipe des ventes. Vous travaillez aussi avec notre responsable des partenariats, notre responsable du design et les agences que vous gérez.
 L’équipe de BDR fait partie des Ventes, et vous êtes responsable de la liste et de la prospection à leurs côtés. Le choix des comptes que nous ciblons est fait conjointement par le Marketing, les Ventes et le CEO.
 Travaillez avec une équipe talentueuse et passionnée

 Une attribution significative d’options d’achat d’actions — nous voulons que chacun chez Botpress pense et agisse en propriétaire, et partage ce que nous construisons
 Programme REER
 Une communauté de bureau dynamique

ABOUT VALPAY 
 At Valpay, we're building the next generation of embedded payments. We help SaaS companies turn payments from a utility into a new line of revenue — our PayFac-as-a-Service model delivers the benefits of integrated payments while we absorb the complexity.
 More than 3,000 merchants across 12 verticals in North America, Europe and Australia run on our platform. Our Growth Pods operate like small business units: each one owns the software partners it acquires, the merchants it activates, and the revenue it grows.
 THE ROLE 
 As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll design, build and operate the data platform behind Valpay's analytics, reporting, product development and day-to-day operational decisions. Payments data is our core asset — every transaction, settlement and merchant interaction flows through systems you'll help shape.
 You'll work alongside Engineering, Product, Finance, Operations and the Growth Pods to make data reliable, accessible and trusted across the company, and increasingly to make it usable by the AI-powered tools and features we're building on top of it.
 This is an on-site role at our Montreal office. We build in person: our data, engineering and Growth Pod teams sit together, and the quickest way to untangle a payments data problem is at a whiteboard with the people who own the system.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 •      Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and ELT/ETL processes across both batch and streaming workloads.
 •      Model and optimize our Snowflake warehouse — dimensional models, dbt transformations, and the semantic layer that analytics and product teams build on.
 •      Build the data foundations for payments reporting: transaction lifecycle, settlement and reconciliation, merchant performance and partner revenue.
 •      Own data quality, integrity, lineage and observability. You'll define what "trustworthy" means here and build the tooling that proves it.
 •      Improve the performance, reliability and cost efficiency of the platform as transaction volumes grow.
 •      Prepare and serve data for AI and LLM use cases — clean, well-documented, well-governed datasets that internal AI tools and customer-facing features can depend on.
 •      Partner with stakeholders across the business to turn open-ended questions into well-scoped data solutions.
 •      Work with software engineers to embed data solutions into customer-facing products and internal systems.
 •      Set and document the standards, patterns and practices the data team will grow into.
 WHAT YOU'LL BRING 
 •      5+ years building and running production data systems as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or in a closely related role.
 •      Advanced SQL and strong Python (or a comparable language), with production engineering habits — version control, testing, code review, CI/CD.
 •      Hands-on experience with our core stack: Snowflake, dbt and Airflow, or close equivalents you can carry across quickly.
 •      Strong data modeling and warehousing fundamentals — dimensional modeling, incremental patterns, slowly changing dimensions — and a working understanding of distributed data systems.
 •      Experience on a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
 •      A track record of working cross-functionally and explaining technical trade-offs to people who don't share your background.
 •      A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
 NICE TO HAVE 
 •      Experience in payments, fintech, financial services or another transaction-heavy, accuracy-critical environment.
 •      Direct exposure to embedded payments, PayFac models, merchant acquiring or payment processing.
 •      Experience building data infrastructure for AI/LLM applications — retrieval pipelines, vector stores, context or feature layers, evaluation datasets.
 •      Fluency with AI-assisted development tools in your day-to-day engineering work.
 •      Real-time streaming and event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis or similar).
 •      Familiarity with data governance, privacy and security in regulated environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, Quebec's Law 25, GDPR).
 •      Experience building customer-facing data products or analytics platforms.
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 •      In your first 90 days, you know our payments data model end to end and have shipped improvements to the pipelines the business depends on most.
 •      By six months, data quality and observability are measurably better — teams trust the numbers and stop rebuilding their own versions of them.
 •      By twelve months, the platform handles materially higher volume without a proportional rise in cost or incidents, and the patterns you've set are how the team builds by default.
 WHY VALPAY

 •      Real ownership. Our Growth Pods run like small businesses. Data isn't a service desk here — it's how decisions get made.
